propositions: The test fails intermittently under xdist `-n 3 --dist worksteal` but passes in isolation because INFO-level log records from `rebar_reconciler` loggers are dropped after the first test that calls the reconciler entrypoint poisons the logger level to WARNING

The existing caplog containment guard in conftest.py only restores the `rebar` root logger level and misses the sibling `rebar_reconciler` root, leaving INFO assertions in reconciler-side tests unprotected from level leaks

The test captures the per-item WARNING line but not the pass-summary INFO line because both use `logging.getLogger(__name__)` on the poisoned `rebar_reconciler` logger, and caplog.at_level(logging.INFO) without a logger argument only raises the ROOT logger level, not the intermediate `rebar_reconciler` logger

The fix generalizes the level restoration from a single scalar REBAR_LOGGER_NAME to a SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES tuple containing both `rebar` and `rebar_reconciler`, making all four primitives in _log_integrity.py operate over the set of shared roots

The `confirm_store is None` path is not the flake mechanism because the per-item WARNING line in the capture proves the store was not None, and a storeless execution would emit neither log line at all
